quote_boxes.t_raw: "Kuntur, Unloved of the Sun"은 그의 부족에서도 배척받았고, 물론 어떤 Saurian도 그와 어울리려 하지 않았다.
quote_boxes.en: "Kuntur, Unloved of the Sun" was also ostracized in his tribe, and of course, no Saurian would buddy up with him.
quote_boxes.speaker: Ranjit

source.quest_ko: 내 동료가 돼라・어릴 적 꿈을 위해!
source.speaker: Ranjit
